entry.title: Who Built It? How Proof of Attribution Gives Credit Where It’s Due?
entry.summary:
Who Built It?
How Proof of Attribution Gives Credit Where It’s Due
In traditional software development or AI research, it’s easy to overlook one crucial question: Who actually built this? A dataset might be compiled by hundreds of people. A model could be fine-tuned over months by a team of engineers. Content might be pulled from the web, cleaned, annotated, and prepped by unseen hands. Yet, when the product goes live a chatbot, a new algorithm, a predictive tool credit is often centralized. The work of contributors gets buried under logos and branding. This is where Proof of Attribution (PoA) steps in a system designed to answer that very question: who contributed what, and how can we make sure they get recognized (and even rewarded)?
